name: Claymorphism
summary: Puffy, rounded 3D shapes in soft pastel colour with double inner shadows and a soft outer shadow, like modelling clay. It followed neumorphism and flat illustration and turns the interface into toys.

philosophy.core_thesis: The interface is a toy: soft, inflated forms with colour make the screen friendly and touchable.
design_principles: Give containers a radius of 24px to 40px and buttons a radius of 999px.
Build depth with 3 shadows: an outer soft shadow (0 16px 32px at 20%), an inner light highlight (inset 8px 8px 16px white at 60%) and an inner dark one (inset -8px -8px 16px at 12%).
Use pastel fills with saturation of 40% to 70% and lightness of 70% to 88%; use 3 to 5 hues on one page.
Set headlines in a rounded, heavy display face at 40px or larger and body in a rounded sans at 16px.
Inflate 3D icons and illustrations to look like clay: round forms, no sharp edges, a 2px lighter rim.
Float shapes at 8px to 24px offsets and give the main object a gentle bob of 6px to 10px.
Keep text on pastel at contrast 4.5:1 or more by using a dark navy (#2B2D54) for body text.
anti_patterns: Flat fills with no inner shadow
Shadows that are only black and hard

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose 12-column grid with 32px gutters; big soft cards and floating objects overlap the grid by 16px to 48px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 45% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 48 and 80px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero with floating objects; cards flush left inside; objects offset by 8px to 24px.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded cards of 24px to 40px; pill buttons; circles for icon containers; no sharp corner.

font_pairings.note: A round, friendly display with a round text face.
A heavy, soft display for big headlines.
A single rounded family that stays light on mobile.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700); display runs at 600 or 700.
Round the numerals and keep tracking at 0.

color.palette_structure: Soft pastel hues on a pale tint, with a dark navy for text.
color.contrast_rules: Navy on cloud holds 11:1; navy on each pastel holds at least 7:1; pastel carries fills, not text.
color.surface_treatment: Soft, matte clay: smooth fills with inner highlight and inner shade.
color.light_and_shadow: Light from the top left: a white inner highlight at the top left and a dark inner shade at the bottom right; the outer shadow falls down.

materiality.surface_simulation: Modelling clay or inflated vinyl, drawn with inner and outer shadows.
materiality.border_rules: No border; the 2px lighter rim comes from the inner highlight.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Outer shadow 0 16px 32px at 20%; inner highlight inset 8px 8px 16px white at 60%; inner shade inset -8px -8px 16px at 12%.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid, chubby icons with a round form and a 3px equivalent weight, in a pastel disc.
ornamentation_details.illustration: 3D rendered clay characters, plants and objects with soft light and round forms.

motion.transition_physics: Soft, springy motion: objects bob by 6px to 10px over 3s; buttons squash by 4% on press and spring back.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the card by 4px and widens the outer shadow by 8px; active state squashes it to scale 0.96.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful, soft and safe, as with a toy.

use_cases: consumer wellness and finance for young users
avoid_when: The audience is professional and data-heavy.
The brand must feel serious or austere.

modifiers.how: Drop the inner shadows and keep the pastel and the radius.
Use one neutral colour and mute the shadows to 10% opacity.
Replace the 3D objects with flat figures and add squiggles.

pack.why: A bold, round, filled family that looks inflated, like clay, inside a pastel disc.

ground.why: Clay surfaces are soft puffed shapes in pastel colour with a deep soft shadow.
